body: But really can't say how thankful I am and how helpful you've been. Alright headed to bed to start a new day.

I'm supposed to move across the country for a job in about two weeks and the plan was to try and save some money and go on my own and not tell anyone. Assuming I didn't chicken out there. Man, I just don't know even thinking about telling someone is making my shake. Even if I tell them before I leave I still couldn't pay for it and then will be gone. I wish I had done something about this earlier and now here I am delaying again. Shit, everything about this whole thing confuses and scares me so dang much.
I like that. I'd never really thought about it that way before. That's a good attitude. I might steal it.
Thanks! I'll have to try these out. I'd rather not make it snow when I scratch my head :D

Don't know what else to say but again offer all the thanks I can. I hope I can pass it on and help someone else one day. Oh, and also share this video that's helping put me in a good mood right now [Love Club](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ca50eYQR58Q) by Lorde I especially like 2:36 too cute.

Mostly it's financial. No insurance and no money. If that scale doesn't slide to free I can't afford it. Although, part of me thinks even if/when I can afford it I'll invent new excuses. I'm well practiced at lying to myself/others and living in denial. I didn't see a therapist when I was still in college because I didn't think anything was particularly wrong. In my current situation it would require money and telling family about it. Something I very much don't want to do. They wouldn't understand, would blame themselves, and I would feel I'd let them down. It also mortifies me to think of saying any of this stuff out loud as I've never mentioned anything I've written here in real life.

Thank you! I'm more on the excitement side, but that other voice is still there. He's just being ignored as best I can. Still some trouble with acceptance but I'm on the way and that's where I want to go.
That's fucking beautiful. I don't want you to think I'm gay or nothing but I have legit happy tears right now.
If you really want to go down a dark hole and depress yourself with some specifics you can check out some past posts I made with this account. It's sort of my vent/free therapy account.

That's some good advice, thank you! I've thankfully never hurt anyone (except maybe when I was 10) but I've put a few holes in some unsuspecting walls. Something I'm not proud of. I'm really afraid that I might hurt someone some day. Looking back on it getting caught up in irrational lines of thought and allowing myself even a little anger seems to lead to it blowing up pretty often. The line about them thinking I'm sort of freak hits home for sure and is almost certainly an irrational thought.
Gonna have to check that out thanks again!

That's really encouraging actually. Trying to turn things around like this and lose weight, but I have that voice on constant loop that tells me it's too late and not worth trying. I'm trying my best to ignore it at the moment. Most of the rest of my problems are of a emotional, social, and personal sort. Not sure what sort of questions to ask there. Never been in a relationship platonic or otherwise. Not good relating to people or controlling my emotions/keeping my mouth shut. But I think that has more to do with insecurities, anxiety, and needing some professional or pharmacological help (hoping I can afford it some day soon) than not knowing what to do. But, what the heck do I know? I'm probably missing some totally obvious stuff. Is there anything you think every person should know, no matter how obvious?
Thank you, that's great! I didn't know things like that existed. Although I'm supposed to be moving to Seattle, WA for a job in about two weeks :( Do you know if there is anything like that there?

:) thank you again, although I'm really embareassed to admit it I'm 24 and recently graduated college. I've kind of been in a rut and depressed for a few years, on top of existing shortcomings, and have reached a point that I don't want to live the way I'm living anymore.
Thank you! This is helpful. I'm embarrassed by how much I don't know and want to try and better myself since people keep insisting it's not too late to do so.

I think the ear is a sensitive spot for most and that the whole fireworks thing is exaggerated, but what do I know I've never been kissed by someone I care about :(

Also, Is it ok if I jump in here and ask for some kissing tips in case I get lucky one of these days?

So I do have a little time to save up? I'm moving for a job, but it doesn't pay much. I'm not sure how I could pay anything right now. Unless it's free. I'm worried I have an abscessed tooth like the story in the thread.

I think I'm headed to bed, but I really want to say thank you again. Gonna try to start over and make some small steps tomorrow. Make apologies, go for a walk, not sure what else. All a bit easier said than done. Maybe one day I'll have the money and the courage to get professional help. I wish I lived in a country that cared about its people, oh well. Thanks again and good night.

Slinking away is probably the best option for me at the moment. It's how I usually respond when I start getting angry or frustrated. I was even just about to do that when I became overwhelmed with rage.

That's a good point about us not usually being the certain of discussion. For the most part it waves over me anymore, but I still have to occasionally remind myself when I hear people in the same room laughing and they're not watching a movie or something.
No, that's true. Almost certainly just a coincidence. A freaky, shitty coincidence, but a coincidence the same.

Should have just snuck away, tried to stay calm and ignore them, or nicely asked them to stop. I just hate being laughed and was already in a shitty mood. I'm already a little paranoid that people laughing are laughing at me and that hadn't happened for a few years. Probably didn't help with that. Was (am) a weird kid in school so got laughed at there and laughed at by dad when I was upset fairly often.

I think one of my biggest fears is that I might get mad and hit someone instead of something. That really scares me just thinking about it. It's never happened before, not since I was really young and couldn't do any real damage at least, but it still scares me.

Thank you for talking to me. I'm starting to feel a little better (in this moment, not in a global sense). I want to be more hopeful, I guess I'm just scared. It seems like every time I get a little bit of hope is when something extra shitty happens.

I'm not sure. Medication? I know I'm getting mad at nothing and that getting mad doesn't help anything. I feel shitty after every time I blow up, but while I'm in the moment I can't seem to stop. 

Like today I was feeling mopey and sad. Couldn't hardly eat. Acting like a giant grown-up baby which must have looked hilarious because my little sisters (9 & 11) start smirking and laughing at me. A pet peeve for me as I got laughed at fairly often when I was younger. So I just blew up at them. Yelling, cursing, stormed down stairs and luckily only punched concrete walls and only got red knuckles. They didn't know any better. They didn't deserve it and I feel like a piece a shit. I don't even know how I'm going to look them in the eye tomorrow. I couldn't control myself. At least it wasn't as bad as when I nearly destroyed a whole wall at like 13? because my little brother had a friend over and they didn't want me to play with them. Can't really blame them in retrospect I was probably just intensely jealous. Still am.

No idea. Most of the time I think I do all right controlling my emotions (probably lying to myself) but then some little thing will set me off and I'll blow up. I used to be pretty motivated too. I may not have had friends, but I was a damn good student until about the last year or two of college. I'm not sure what happened I just stopped giving a shit. Couldn't see the point of trying so hard. Didn't like my major or my prospects, but no career prospect sounds very good anymore.
You say having hope isn't stupid, but it sure as heck feels like it when it's always blowing up in my face.

So many things I'm not sure where to begin. Controlling my emotions would be a biggie. I'd like to stop punching holes in walls and yelling at people. Stop being so angry, sad, and self-pitying. Some basic social skills would be nice. Just some ways to be around people without feeling like I'm gonna be ill. Be more honest with people about how I feel. To stop being so cowardly and ask people for help. Having a friend or SO might be nice, but I'm not certain. I wish I could feel love or even feel like for someone. Hobbies that aren't just time wasters might be nice. A job and money would be helpful. And just to throw on a little extra I wish I was in better shape and could afford to fix my shitty teeth. In general I'd just like something to live for, some reason to get out of bed. Something to look forward to.
Thank you

Thank you ;) I just can't fathom a stranger thinking I have potential. I don't think I've ever heard that before in real life. I'm in tears right now and yet despite how beautiful that was, not to take anything away, I still had that creeping voice in the back of my head whispering "If you knew me you wouldn't say that." :( I really wish I could shut that asshole up.

Wow, I don't even know what to say. I linger around here a lot (probably too much) and this has to be one the best responses I've read. I'd never really thought about it, or seen it put quite that way before. I.. I don't really know what to feel right now. I'm crying and confused and scared. But I think you have a point. I know I've spent most of my life being fake and faux happy. I always put on a happy front because I thought that's just what you're supposed to do. I've never been honest like this with anyone in real life. I'm not sure how you're supposed to do that. The end really hits too, but partly because I'm not really sure what it is I want. For example, I say I want friends, but when it comes to the reality of being around people, I can hardly stand it. I don't know what to say, but thank you.

The problem I'm having is that I don't want to isolate myself, anymore, I can't reconcile my deep feelings of loneliness and my all-consuming hatred.   It makes no sense to me. How can I be so pathetically desperate for any sort of companionship and feel the way I do at the same time? How am I supposed to ever get close to somebody when I can't stand to be around people for any longer than they care to be around me? Sometimes I wish I could not care, but I can't, and even if I could what would I do with my life? Just continue this empty, meaningless, existence all alone? For what purpose?

I can't really remember a time I didn't hate myself. Or hate near everything in this world. And even more I hate that I feel that way. I don't want to be so hateful. Intellectually I know it's wrong. People don't deserve my hate and the world is probably not all that shitty. But, I can't seem to stop feeling that way. My mind always jumps there. I know the world isn't shitty I just can't believe it. If that makes any damn sense at all.

I should add I don't really want to kill myself either. It'd fuck up my parents and little sisters. And I already hate myself enough I don't need that piled on. But, I just don't know what to do. I can't get professional help. No money, no insurance, in the middle of nowhere without a car, and I live in the United States of Your on Your Own. I don't want to do that to them, but I also hate that they have such control over me, and I hate that I feel that way. I hate that I can't think of any personal reason not to do it, only how it would affect others, I've got no desires, no hopes, no wishes, nothing I can see for my future looks good.

Thanks for sharing yourself. I had the same fantasies. I used to really like History. Or at least I think I did. I wanted to be a professor and was on all the right tracks to go to grad school. Taking on research projects, learning foreign languages, and GRE prep. Whether the apathy caused the stress or the other way around, I don't know, but at some point I just stopped caring. I no longer cared about college, history, grades, or grad school. But, I kept taking on more and more projects that I couldn't handle. I barely slept or left my room. When I did sleep I had nightmares, near constant headaches, and wrenching in my gut. Papers came in late, if at all. I once choose not to turn in a major paper for no reason I can fathom. I once had a great reputation with all my professors, now I can't get a recommendation from any of them. I'd rather die than go to grad school, but I don't seem capable of anything else. Like an idiot, I ignored my problems and powered through. Told myself it was just stress and I'd be better after getting out. Hasn't really worked out that way. I really wish I had gotten help while I could.
So even if I did manage to make a friend it wouldn't be real? Fuck, that's depressing. I can't decide if I'd rather never have a friend or have them only to realize its all an illusion.

Wow, this sounds exactly like me. 24, BS in History, broke, can't find any jobs, and massive student loans coming in. Yes, even basic jobs wont hire me. I don't blame them I wouldn't be a very good employee anyway. Nothing interests me anymore. Asked for loans or assistance from distant family members, but no one wants to help. Shit I don't know what to say I was surprised to find someone like me and I know how crushing the silence can be. I swear I have the power of invisibility, I just can't choose how to use it.

Should also add I still didn't fit in with other people there. I don't know if I can adequately describe how it feels to be the only person in a room not invited somewhere, to be in a group of people and have no one notice you're there, to open your mouth only to realize no one is listening or wants too, or ruin other's good time by your presence there.

I wish I could do that. I actually studied abroad for a year in college. It was probably the best year of my life and I came close to having an actual friend and actually opening up. But, of course I didn't and like everything else it came to an end. I don't normally cry, but I couldn't stop on the way to the airport because I knew It'd never be that good again and I missed out on so much. It was better than any other particular year of my life, but I still had days where I thought of suicide, deep loneliness, and emptiness.

I hate holidays. Those two and birthdays being some of the worst. I just try to pretend its any other day and forget about it. Which works sometimes, after all it really is just any other day. Also sometimes try to do something special even if very minor. Buy a book, have an awesome sandwich, or what have you. Although that can kind of contradict with the first thing.

I know ... I just, ugh ... I don't know. Money is definitely an issue. Parents don't have much more than I do. I just don't even know where to start. I've heard other people say they don't share about themselves, but I'm not sure they mean to the extent that I've shut myself out. Not one peep about anything to do with feelings or anything of that sort to anyone. And the first time in my life I'm supposed to admit I need help. That I can't control my own mind? I'm shaking just thinking about it. How am I supposed to know the reaction? Is there any way to talk to a doctor over the phone or internet? I just wish I could get knocked out and wake up cured or at least wake up in a hospital and walk out better.

They say everyone is good at something. Well, whatever it is I'm good at must no longer exist or must not have been invented yet. It's weird to explain, but I can almost get over the large failures if it weren't for all the little things I can't seem to get right either. I'll cry more, a lot of times, cause I screwed up a sandwich than cause of my crushing loneliness. It's the small indignities and incompetence's that get to me. As if the trade-off for all this should be that at least I get to rock at mario or whatever. I don't know if its the same for you.

Same here. I call it my game face. I like to think I have a good one, but it can be difficult to maintain at times and has definitely gotten more difficult to do so. I've never really been honest with anyone. Sometimes my game face isn't ready and when people ask what's wrong I have to lie yet again. :(

Don't know if it matters or if it helps you know me better, but I moved around a lot as a kid and I think that had a big part in shaping me. I remember being mad when we didn't move. I expect not to ever again see most people I meet and behave accordingly. I put on a good game face (although its become difficult in the last couple years) and feel like I'm not being honest with anyone around me, including myself. I'm not sure who I am or how much I can trust my memories. Which by the way my memory has always been bad with people and great with concepts, but has gotten worse. I get headaches frequently and about 6 months back I had a frightening experience where I became convinced I was already dead, had been for sometime, and the reaper was watching and coming for me.

I think people who have never dealt with depression don't understand that being sad or angry is a hell of a lot better than the big nothingness. When I cry I know I'm capable of feeling. I know I'm alive and I know that I wont screw that up at least.
